# flowapi

> Types from API descriptions that follow the specification: Swagger 2.0, OpenAPI 3.0 to 3.2 and JSON Schema in, TypeScript or Rust out.

flowapi reads an API description into a graph of types and prints it as TypeScript or as Rust
(serde types). Every value a schema accepts, its type accepts: each schema of the official JSON
Schema Test Suite is turned into a type and each test value is checked against it by the
TypeScript compiler, and every valid value passes. With `--sdk` it also prints, per operation, a
function that writes the request and one that reads the response, sending nothing itself; and
`flowapi generate` writes a whole TypeScript client package from the description and a small config
(`flowapi-sdk.yml`): resources, retries, errors, pagination, tests. It is a
Rust command (`cargo install --git https://github.com/localixai/flowapi --tag v0.3.0
flowapi-cli`) and an npm package compiled to WebAssembly (`npx @localix-ai/flowapi`), MIT-licensed,
from https://github.com/localixai/flowapi, made by Localix Lab (https://localix.ai).
